rules: Same artifact_sha256 is never stored twice.
Same observation idempotency key returns the prior receipt.
Hash equality means byte/content equality only, not legal permission or semantic identity.
Canonicalization version is required in every hash receipt.

resume_rules: Resume after the last committed receipt only.
Never advance a cursor before artifact and observation receipt commit.
Reprocessing the same page is safe because artifact and observation keys are idempotent.

ENDED_SUSPECTED: source returns explicit ended marker once
canonical page unavailable once without deletion evidence
ENDED_CONFIRMED: explicit ended marker in two successful observations
authorized source API reports terminal state
guardrails: Transient network failure cannot confirm end or deletion.
Rights block changes public status to BLOCKED_RIGHTS without claiming source deletion.
Every terminal transition preserves prior source_url, artifact_id, hashes, and evidence refs.

minimum_evidence: same canonical source identity OR owner-authorized cross-source identity link

rules: Similarity is never promoted to confirmed identity by score alone.
Private exact address, owner contact, unit number, and raw notes are forbidden evidence in public-facing output.
Human or authoritative-source decision is required to change ESTIMATED_SIMILAR_LISTING to CONFIRMED_SAME_LISTING.

excluded_inputs: rights FORBIDDEN or REVIEW_REQUIRED source content
evidence_requirements: Every score component has evidence_ref and source_ref.
Period start/end and updated_at are mandatory.
Methodology version and deterministic tie-break are mandatory.

acceptance_tests.expected: same artifact_sha256 produces one artifact and duplicate receipt
replay from checkpoint produces no duplicate mutation
confidence below 1 remains ESTIMATED_SIMILAR_LISTING and merge_allowed=false
score period evidence source and updated_at all present
